first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The slender dark gray long gun held by Person A in the foreground, with light-colored marks on the gun body and a protruding sighting structure at the front.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The dark gray handgun subsequently raised by Person A, located mainly in the lower right of the image.

entities.name: muddy shell-cratered ground
entities.identification: The dark, undulating muddy ground, depressions, and band of gray rubble in the foreground and middle ground.

entities.name: cluster of ruined walls and rubble
entities.identification: The cluster of gray ruined walls with jagged top edges, partial door and window openings, and exposed stone blocks.

entities.name: cluster of dead trees
entities.identification: The cluster of slender, leafless tree trunks with a small number of short branches in the middle and far distance.

entities.name: smoke-cloud-filled sky
entities.identification: The area of sky above the ruins that is gray-white, dark gray, and locally yellow-green.

entities.name: orange point of fire
entities.identification: The collection of irregular orange-yellow open flames near the muddy ground and ruined walls.

entities.name: damaged vertical flag
entities.identification: The fabric flag with dark and light bands on the flagpole, with part of the flag visible hanging down in the upper left.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person in the passage wearing a dark helmet with a brim, a dark uniform, and a bulging backpack, and holding a firearm at the ready.

entities.name: bright tracer burst
entities.identification: The collection of slender orange-white bright lines that appears intermittently during the exchange of fire.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The first-person gun holder, of whom mainly gloved hands, wrists, and parts of the sleeves are visible in the image.

entities.name: ruins smoke cloud
entities.identification: The gray-white to dark gray bands and columns of smoke near the ruined walls and open flames.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: The slender dark firearm held at the ready by Person B.

entities.name: airborne debris
entities.identification: The collection of dark fine particles and larger elongated and block-shaped objects in the air.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: Another dark-clad person near the flames on the left, farther away than Person B.
